text:
maria: Heads-up — ops wants to start sunsetting the v1 auth flow next week. Docs PRs need quick fixes: auth examples, SDK snippets, and the migration guide. Can folks volunteer to triage? :warning:

sam: I can take SDK snippets (JS + Python). need to know exact param changes.

maria: thx @sam. v1 used `api_key` as a top-level param; v2 requires an `auth` object and explicit `type` = 'bearer'. also server-side tokens now use `x-rw-service` header for intents.

ashley: opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-ai/docs/pull/4823 — it touches /guides/migration and /sdk/js/examples. i left TODOs for examples that call the old `client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey })` pattern.

igor: quick snippet for the new JS usage:
```js
// v2 auth pattern
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  auth: { type: 'bearer', token: process.env.RW_KEY },
});
```

igor: python equivalent:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(auth={"type": "bearer", "token": os.environ.get("RW_KEY")})
```

kevin: will existing customers see 401s or a deprecation header? need to update release notes if we break behavior.

maria: we emit a deprecation warning for 14 days if the old header is used, then 401. sample server log:
```
[2026-03-27T12:02:14Z] WARN auth: deprecated api_key header detected for client_id=acme-42; migrate to auth.type='bearer' by 2026-04-10
[2026-04-11T00:01:00Z] ERROR auth: rejected request: missing v2 auth object
```

sam: thanks. i'll add an explicit note in each SDK example that includes fallback guidance and a quick migration diff.

ashley: docs-bot ran link-check and flagged two broken anchors in the migration guide: /guides/migration#auth-changes and /sdk/js#old-init. i pushed a tiny commit to fix anchors.

docs-bot: Link check results: 2 broken anchors found — fixed in https://github.com/redwood-ai/docs/commit/9b7c4a1

maria: action items:
- sam: update JS/Python snippets + add migration diff (owner)
- igor: add Go + curl examples for v2 auth (can be minimal)
- ashley: land the PR and ping legal for the release note blurb
- kevin: coordinate with eng for the 14-day soft-deprecation window and email cadence

sam: i'll also add a tiny smoke test to the examples repo that runs `node examples/auth-check.js` with both old and new auth to show the warning vs 401. example command i plan to add:
```
# run smoke test locally
RW_KEY=old-key node examples/auth-check.js || true
```

kevin: pinging infra — we need a canary to verify the deprecation header emits properly in regional clusters.

ashley: timeline proposal: patch docs today, ship release note tomorrow, enable soft-deprecation Tue 2026-04-01, enforce 2026-04-15. ok?

maria: sounds good. please keep PR descriptions explicit: add 'migration: v1->v2 auth' label and list changed files.

igor: one more note — the model-swap path also needs a doc blurb: some customers used the old aliasing with auth-based routing; that behavior will default to model fallback now. i'll draft a 2-paragraph note and paste into the migration guide.

sam: fint. i'll open a follow-up PR for snippets later today.

maria: thanks team — i'll compile the release note once PRs are merged. feel free to @maria in PR comments for merge priority. :rocket:
